blocks.prompt: 5 If \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = -\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\) and \(\underline{w} = 3\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + \underline{k}\), find a unit vector parallel to \(4\underline{u} - 3\underline{v} + 2\underline{w}\).
blocks.explanation:
Two skills together: combining vectors, then making a unit vector.
We must find \(\underline{r} = 4\underline{u} - 3\underline{v} + 2\underline{w}\) and then \(\underline{r}/|\underline{r}|\).
Plan: scale each vector, combine components, find the length, divide.
steps:
Given: \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = -\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = 3\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + \underline{k}\).
To find: a unit vector parallel to \(\underline{r} = 4\underline{u} - 3\underline{v} + 2\underline{w}\).
Method: build \(\underline{r}\) component by component, then \(\hat{r} = \underline{r}/|\underline{r}|\).

Scale the three vectors
\[4\underline{u} = 8\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 12\underline{k}\]
\[3\underline{v} = -3\underline{i} + 12\underline{j} + 6\underline{k}\]
\[2\underline{w} = 6\underline{i} - 4\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\]
Why: Each component is multiplied by the scalar in front.

Combine the components
\[\underline{i}: 8 - (-3) + 6 = 17\]
\[\underline{j}: 4 - 12 + (-4) = -12\]
\[\underline{k}: -12 - 6 + 2 = -16\]
\[\underline{r} = 17\underline{i} - 12\underline{j} - 16\underline{k}\]
Why: \(3\underline{v}\) is subtracted, so its components change sign.

Find \(|\underline{r}|\)
\[|\underline{r}| = \sqrt{17^2 + (-12)^2 + (-16)^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{289 + 144 + 256}\]
\[= \sqrt{689}\]
Why: Magnitude formula. \(689 = 13 \times 53\) has no square factor.

Divide by \(|\underline{r}|\)
\[\hat{r} = \dfrac{17\underline{i} - 12\underline{j} - 16\underline{k}}{\sqrt{689}}\]
Why: This vector has length 1 and the direction of \(\underline{r}\). Its negative, \(-\hat{r}\), is also parallel (opposite sense).

Check
\[\dfrac{289 + 144 + 256}{689} = \dfrac{689}{689} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Why: The squared length of \(\hat{r}\) is 1.
blocks.final_answer: \(\dfrac{17\underline{i} - 12\underline{j} - 16\underline{k}}{\sqrt{689}}\) (its negative is the parallel unit vector in the opposite sense)
